ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0006 is decisive in Part VIII: it requires that no physiological measure determine governance standing, and CTD-0005 adds subsistence to the protected list. The shipped bright-line formulation, which names speak, vote, lead, receive subsistence, and hold equal political standing, is stronger than the baseline's and is kept. CTD-0076 requires Scale as the singular and ICONS only as the plural, which changed several restored sentences in the first Scale and dragon chapters. CTD-0030 forbids presenting the Cardinal Scale as existing. CTD-0036 requires the eighty-seven, one hundred and fifty, and five hundred figures to remain distinct with their nesting explained. CTD-0069 governs the use of cultural traditions, which bears on the dragon material. CTD-0081 forbids numerology as evidence and was read. CTD-0012 keeps the Currency of Presence, COHERENCE, and Bio-Consensus distinct.

findings.summary: The bright lines were restated in the shipped text and the reason they exist was removed.

evidence.baseline: the history of measuring human beings is largely a history of measuring them in order to control them. The same instrument that could recognize presence as a civic capacity could, in the wrong architecture, become the most refined apparatus of control ever built ... These are not features. They are the conditions under which the measurement is permitted to exist at all.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0006, applied to biometric governance standing.
findings.diagnosis: The shipped bright-line formulation is stronger than the baseline's and is kept verbatim, including the subsistence and equal standing clauses that answer CTD-0005 and CTD-0006. What the paydown removed is why the lines exist and what their status is: conditions of permission rather than product features. That framing is the difference between a safeguard and a policy.

findings.summary: The chapter's actual proposal, and its most careful sentence, were removed.

evidence.baseline: It proposes something subtler: that a community engaged in a consequential decision might be able to know whether it is, in that moment, in a state likely to produce wisdom ... and, if they are not, to wait, to repair, to return when the conditions for deliberation are actually present. Not data instead of politics. Not a gate on who counts.
evidence.shipped: Even within those limits, evidence of collective regulation should remain advisory.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0006, applied to the proposal itself.
findings.diagnosis: The shipped advisory framing is required and is kept. It is not the proposal. The baseline says what the measurement would be for: a group noticing that it cannot decide well and choosing to wait. The two denials, not data instead of politics and not a gate on who counts, are the volume's own guard against the reading CTD-0006 was raised against, and they were removed while the item they serve stayed open.

debtImpact.note: The shipped bright lines are kept in full and the restored proposal is explicitly bounded by them. No sensor decides who may speak, vote, or lead.
The subsistence clause in the shipped bright lines is kept, so no measure may condition subsistence.
The restored passage makes no numerological claim.

reasoning.note: R-LEDGER-WINS. Every shipped bright line is kept in the shipped wording, which names speak, vote, lead, receive subsistence, and hold equal political standing. The restored proposal sits inside those lines and the shipped advisory statement immediately follows it.
R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Five em dashes. Three were parenthetical appositives and became comma pairs. Two introduced specifications of the proposal and became commas.

The shipped requirements that human judgment, disagreement, disability access, non-biometric participation, appeal, and the right to refuse remain prior, and the shipped closing that the proposal is modest and difficult.
The historical reason for the bright lines, the conditions of permission framing, the proposal with its two denials, and the closing interlude on measuring what allows us to become wise together.

openQuestions: The restored proposal, that a community might know whether it is in a state likely to deliberate well, is the passage CTD-0006 most directly concerns. It is restored inside every shipped safeguard and with both denials returned. Whether the proposal may be stated at all before the mechanism exists is the author's decision and the item is still open.
The baseline's for ten thousand years in the closing interlude was reduced to for a very long time. The specific span is unsourced and CTD-0013 and CTD-0078 both bear on historical extraction claims.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-04 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The section is the volume's most careful ledger interaction: a high severity item, a shipped formulation better than the baseline's, and a removed proposal that the item does not forbid. Keeping the formulation and restoring the proposal inside it is what R-LEDGER-WINS produces when the item bounds rather than prohibits.
